اقلعفتا (form IVq)
# اِقْلَعَفَّتَا (iqlaʕaffatā) /iq.la.ʕaf.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# اُقْلُعِفَّتَا (uqluʕiffatā) /uq.lu.ʕif.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
